items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: The name 'Rob' is mentioned by the interviewer asking for permission to continue ('Can I finish it, Rob?'), but the interviewee does not speak or respond to this mention in the provided context.

ctx.x: About Ann Hager's Children's Blues. Wait a minute. Especially, quote, I like you because you have such loving ways. Unquote. Unquote. Ann Hager's Children's Blues. I'm sorry, I beg your pardon. Unquote. Ann Hager's Children's Blues. Unquote. Which are our plug numbers. Can I finish it, Rob?

Give my kindest regards to Mr. Russell Robinson, if he is still with you. With best wishes, we beg to remain very truly yours. Handy Brothers Music Company, Incorporated. P.S. If you have a photograph of the original Dixie Line jazz band, one that I could use for a title cover of St. Louis Blues, would like very, very much for you to rest saying to me so that I could use this for our next issue.
